request:
Create a 4-requester round-robin arbiter module named `rr_arbiter`.

Ports: `clk` (input), `rst` (input, active-high synchronous reset), `req` (input, 4 bits), `grant` (output, 4 bits, one-hot or zero).

Behavior: `grant` is combinational from the current `req` and an internal registered pointer `last` (2 bits, index of the most recently granted requester; reset value 3 so that requester 0 has the highest priority after reset). Each cycle, the arbiter grants the first requesting index found when searching in the order last+1, last+2, last+3, last (mod 4), i.e. starting just after the last granted requester. `grant` has exactly one bit set when `req` is nonzero and is 0 when `req` is 0. At every rising clock edge where `grant` is nonzero, `last` is updated to the granted index; when `grant` is 0, `last` holds. No parameters.
